payload.recallText: I wanted to teach my students about the Oregon Trail. All of their characters they've chosen are real people, who died on the Oregon Trail (I looked it up). I wanted to take them on a journey so they'd understand, so I took them on a walk 20 blocks (about 2 miles) through Manhattan. I didn't want the parent teacher conference, so "ah a stream, how fortunate" and let him drink. Then back to the class and all sweaty. The students are excited to play the game each day, thinking any one of them can die (not that I'm letting that happen), but it keeps them involved.
